race.description: Rick Arnett Appreciation Stakes Prov. Mdn Plate
race.comment: ANTHROPOID (11) ran some respectable races in Group company last prep and resumed with a tough on-pace fourth over 1200m at Illawarra Grange. Drops in weight and can assert his class in this winnable race. GOLDEN GODDESS (12) away only fairly on debut and found the 1200m too short when fifth over 1200m at Canterbury. Look for her to be doing her best work late. BOBBY (1) claims helps today after he was collared late when second over 1206m at Port Macquarie. Can take control early and prove hard reel in. MR REIBY (3) improving with racing and the tongue-tie goes on. Slim prospects.
